words: I think for what I'm looking for, based on the games that I have in mind, the sprites are more in line with what I want. But I don't want to discount the 3D version because that seems kind of cool, and who knows what I might do with that in the future. (Delivery target: Cycles strand-fur sprites primary, live 3D glTF kept as secondary output; supersedes 2026-10-14 3D-first.)
